title: Call Santa — Laptop POC
summary: Run-and-test guide for the zero-dependency laptop proof of concept that connects a browser mic to an OpenAI Realtime Santa voice agent.
scope: explicitly out of scope: phone booth, GPIO hook switch, scheduling/admin UI, PIN override, Grafana/Prometheus, weatherproofing, OFF-state recording
notes: README of an already-built POC: prose + runbook structure (setup steps, env vars, testing checklist) with no Decision/Consequences, user stories, or API contracts. Implementation facts it establishes (stdlib server holds the API key, browser receives only ~10-minute ephemeral tokens, default model gpt-realtime, default voice ash, mic works on localhost without HTTPS, 5-minute auto-wrap, persona in SANTA_INSTRUCTIONS) are as-built context, not forward-looking requirements. Mild SPEC signal from the file-role and env-var tables was resolved toward DOC because they document current behavior rather than binding contracts. References a PRD latency target of <2s p95 as a testing cue only — the authoritative statement lives in ../call-santa-pre-prd.md.
